decision_basis: Service demand and rising CFO support genuine growth, but 47.18x trailing earnings, receivable absorption, other-income support and warrant dilution materially offset per-share returns. Strong liquidity and a volume-backed rebound preserve upside without proving value.
manager_assessment: Agree independently with the manager: financing feasibility and constructive timing are meaningful but the premium still requires stronger per-share conversion.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
